## Svirfneblin Riding Slug (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
N Large animal  
Init—2; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +12  

**Defense**

 **AC** 17, touch 7, flat-footed 17 (-2 Dex, +10  natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 66 (7d8+35)  
**Fort** +10, **Ref** +0, **Will** +5  
**Immune** critical hits, sneak attack  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 25 ft., climb 25 ft.  
**Melee** two slams +10 (2d6+6)  
**Ranged** acid spit +3 touch (3d6 acid, Range 20 ft.)  

**Tactics**

 **Before Combat** Svirfneblin riding slugs climb along ceilings, waiting for a light source to come nearby to drop onto with a slam attack.  

 **During Combat** Svirfneblin riding slugs attack the nearest opponent, and if enemies go into hiding it assaults the closest light source or warm body.  

 **Morale** Svirfneblin riding slugs retreat when reduced to 15 hp or less.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 22, **Dex** 6, **Con** 21, **Int** 1, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 7  
**Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +12; **CMD** 20 (cannot be tripped)  
**Feats** Skill Focus (Perception), Skill Focus (Stealth), Weapon Focus (acid spit), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative.*  
**Skills** Climb +18, Perception +12, Stealth +3  
**SQ** amorphous, compression  

**Ecology**

**Environment** underground  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or clutch (4-10)  
**Treasure** none
